properties.name: Arlington Microtransit (MICRO)
properties.note: Pilot zones (North/South) are in northwest Arlington, bounded by North Glebe Rd, Langston Blvd and the county line (arlingtontransit.com); no stated size, county shown as proxy.

properties.name: Bay Transit Express
properties.note: Official geofence from the agency's GTFS-Flex feed (data.trilliumtransit.com/gtfs/baytransit-va-us/baytransit-va-us--flex-v2.zip), route 76295, real-time booking. Fetched 2026-09-10. Feed covers only the original Gloucester zone; the app's West Point/Tappahannock/New Kent zones (added since) are not yet in this feed.

properties.name: GLTC Flex
properties.note: Designated zone inside Lynchburg bounded by Graves Mill Rd, Old Graves Mill Rd, Enterprise Dr, Timberlake Rd, LYH airport, Jefferson Ridge Pkwy, Forest Rd, Wyndhurst (gltconline.com/flex); no stated size, city limits shown as proxy.

properties.name: HRT OnDemand
properties.units: buffer 3.52 km @ Virginia Beach city; buffer 4.06 km @ Newport News city; buffer 3.05 km @ Chesapeake city; buffer 2.21 km @ Hampton city; clipped to Virginia Beach city; Newport News city; Chesapeake city; Hampton city
properties.note: Four independent zones, each within its own named independent city, with sizes confirmed via gohrt.com/services/ondemand/: Virginia Beach ~15 sq mi, Newport News ~20 sq mi, Chesapeake ~11.3 sq mi, Hampton ~5.9 sq mi. Circles centered on each city and clipped to city limits.

properties.name: LC Transit On Demand
properties.note: Two independent zones in Loudoun County (~5-6 sq mi and ~14 sq mi); trips cannot cross zones.

properties.name: METGo!
properties.source: Agency GTFS-Flex feed (Mountain Empire Transit, MetGO! route)
properties.units: GTFS-Flex locations.geojson, area_1079 (route 76328 / MetGO!, real-time booking)
properties.note: Official geofence published in the agency's GTFS-Flex feed (data.trilliumtransit.com/gtfs/mountainempire-va-us), not a Census-derived proxy. Excludes area_1080 (route 76329), a separate prior-day-booking service on the same feed that is out of ODT scope. Fetched 2026-09-10.

properties.name: MetroFLX
properties.note: Official geofence from the agency's GTFS-Flex feed (data.trilliumtransit.com/gtfs/valleymetro-va-us/valleymetro-va-us--flex-v2.zip), route 77402. Fetched 2026-09-10.

properties.name: MicroCAT (Charlottesville Area Transit)
properties.note: Service zones (Pantops area and Route 29 North corridor) are small subsets of Albemarle County; no published size. Service is limited to the Pantops area and Route 29 North corridor within Albemarle County, not countywide. Checked charlottesville.gov/microcat (404 at time of check), albemarle.org's "Meet MicroCAT" post, dailyprogress.com, and infocville.com coverage: all describe a zone map for the two sub-areas but none states a square-mile size or boundary streets. No usable size data to build an approximate circle -- needs the MicroCAT zone map (in-app or via CAT) for a human to trace.

properties.name: OmniRide Connect
properties.units: Manassas Park city; Dumfries town; Triangle CDP; Quantico town
properties.note: Two separate zones: Manassas Park and Dumfries/Quantico corridor in Prince William County.
